query:
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(r.event_cursor), 0) FROM transcript_segment_revisions r
               JOIN transcript_segments s ON s.id = r.segment_id
               WHERE s.broadcast_id = $1 AND r.received_at <= $2

SELECT COALESCE(MAX(revision.event_cursor), 0)
            FROM transcript_segment_revisions revision
            JOIN transcript_segments segment ON segment.id = revision.segment_id
            WHERE segment.broadcast_id = ANY($1)
SELECT batch_index,attempt,status,response,error_code,request_snapshot,created_at FROM meeting_topic_structure_batches WHERE structure_id=$1 ORDER BY batch_index,attempt
SELECT batch_index,request_snapshot,response FROM meeting_topic_structure_batches WHERE structure_id=$1 AND status='READY' ORDER BY batch_index,attempt

SELECT DISTINCT ON (segment.id)
                   segment.id, revision.id, segment.broadcast_id, segment.source_segment_id,
                   revision.event_cursor, revision.text, revision.speaker_label,
                   revision.is_final, revision.received_at, revision.content_hash,
                   revision.source_payload
            FROM transcript_segments segment
            JOIN transcript_segment_revisions revision ON revision.segment_id = segment.id
            WHERE segment.broadcast_id = ANY($1) AND revision.event_cursor <= $2
            ORDER BY segment.id, revision.event_cursor DESC

SELECT id, lifecycle_status, EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM watch_topic_episodes e JOIN watch_sessions s ON s.id=e.session_id
                WHERE s.broadcast_id=live_broadcasts.id AND e.status IN ('OPEN','WAITING')
            ) AS watched
            FROM live_broadcasts
            WHERE (
                    (institution = 'LEGISLATURE' AND source_system = 'assembly.webcast.go.kr')
                    OR (institution = 'EXECUTIVE' AND source_system = 'ktv.go.kr')
                  )
              AND (
                    lifecycle_status = 'LIVE'
                    OR (lifecycle_status = 'ENDED'
                        AND (ended_at >= now() - interval '1 hour' OR EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1 FROM watch_topic_episodes episode
                            JOIN watch_sessions session ON session.id=episode.session_id
                            WHERE session.broadcast_id=live_broadcasts.id
                              AND episode.status='WAITING'

SELECT DISTINCT ON (content_hash) content_hash, live_insight
               FROM transcript_utterance_summaries
               WHERE broadcast_id=$1 AND content_hash=ANY($2)
               ORDER BY content_hash,created_at DESC

SELECT e.status,e.details,e.session_id,r.kakao_enabled,e.rule_revision,r.current_revision
                   FROM watch_topic_episodes e JOIN watch_sessions s ON s.id=e.session_id JOIN watch_rules r ON r.id=s.rule_id
                   WHERE s.broadcast_id=$1 AND s.subscriber_id=$2 AND e.started_cursor<=$3 AND r.enabled

SELECT DISTINCT ON (brief.broadcast_id)
                   brief.id, brief.broadcast_id, brief.transcript_hash,
                   brief.source_last_event_cursor, brief.provider, brief.model,
                   brief.prompt_version, brief.authority_status,
                   brief.review_status, brief.brief, brief.usage_metadata,
                   brief.generated_at
            FROM meeting_briefs brief
            JOIN live_broadcasts broadcast ON broadcast.id = brief.broadcast_id
            WHERE (
                broadcast.institution <> 'LEGISLATURE'
                OR broadcast.committee_name = ANY($1)
            )
              AND broadcast.source_system NOT IN (
                'poc07.demo', 'poc07.test', 'poc07.replay.local',
                'poc07.replay.kakao'
              )
            ORDER BY brief.broadcast_id,
                     (brief.provider IN ('mistral', 'nvidia', 'openrouter', 'openai', 'gemini', 'groq')) DESC,
                     brief.generated_at DESC, brief.id DE

SELECT MIN(e.started_cursor) FROM watch_topic_episodes e
                       JOIN watch_sessions s ON s.id=e.session_id
                       JOIN watch_rules r ON r.id=s.rule_id
                       WHERE s.broadcast_id=$1 AND e.status<>'CANCELED'
                         AND r.enabled AND e.rule_revision=r.current_revision

SELECT content_hash FROM transcript_utterance_summary_failures
               WHERE broadcast_id = $1 AND content_hash = ANY($2)
                 AND provider = $3 AND model = $4 AND prompt_version = $5
                 AND retry_after > now()
SELECT id,source_snapshot,result FROM meeting_topic_structures WHERE meeting_brief_id=$1 AND source_hash=$2 AND version=$3 AND status='READY'
